exact.Sa raunde kundër CPU?: How many rounds against the computer?
exact.Raundin e fiton kush ka më shumë pikë. L: The higher score wins each round. Whoever wins more rounds wins the game.
exact.Një raund, kush merr më shumë pikë fiton: One round: the higher score wins.
exact.Secili merr 4 karta. Në mes vendosen 4 k: Each player is dealt 4 cards. Four cards are placed in the middle, but only the top card is face up.
exact.Me radhë hidhni nga një kartë mbi grumbu: Players take turns placing one card on the pile. If your card has the same rank as the top card, you capture the whole pile.
exact.Fanti (J) e merr grumbullin gjithmonë, ç: A Jack (J) always captures the pile, no matter which card is on top.
exact.kur në mes ka vetëm një kartë dhe ti e m: when the pile has only one card and you capture it with a card of the same rank, you score 10 points. A Jack on a Jack scores 20.
exact.Kur mbarojnë kartat në dorë ndahen nga 4: When both hands are empty, each player is dealt 4 new cards. Cards left on the table at the end go to the last player who captured.
exact.Pikët e raundit: më shumë karta 3, çdo A: Scoring per round: most cards 3, each Ace 1, each Jack 1, 2 of clubs (2♣) 2, 10 of diamonds (10♦) 3, plus Pishpirik bonuses.
exact.Para lojës zgjidhni sa raunde (1–10). Ra: Before the game, choose the number of rounds (1–10). The higher score wins each round; whoever wins more rounds wins the game.
exact.Kuq e bardhë, si në kafene: Red and white, like in a café
